See also: sālīta and sālītā

Esperanto

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /saˈlita/
  • Rhymes: -ita
  • Syllabification: sa‧li‧ta

Adjective

[edit]

salita (accusative singular salitan, plural salitaj, accusative plural salitajn)

  1. singular past passive participle of sali

Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /saˈli.ta/
  • Rhymes: -ita
  • Hyphenation: sa‧lì‧ta

Etymology 1

[edit]

Deverbal formed with the feminine past participle of salire (“to go up”).

Noun

[edit]

salita f (plural salite)

  1. climb
  2. increase, rise
Antonyms
[edit]
  • discesa

Etymology 2

[edit]

See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.

Participle

[edit]

salita

  1. feminine singular of salito

Anagrams

[edit]
  • alasti, astila, lisata, salati, saltai

Kapampangan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Old Malay (compare modern Malay cerita (“tale”)), from Sanskrit चरित (carita, “course of life”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /səˈlitəʔ/ [səˈliː.təʔ]
  • Hyphenation: sa‧li‧ta

Noun

[edit]

salítâ

  1. story; word; vocabulary
  2. (linguistics) language
  3. (by extension) speech; dialect
    Synonyms: amanu, pamanyabi, diyalektu
  4. something said
    Synonyms: sabi, ngara, ngana, ngaku
  5. promise; word; affirmation
    Synonyms: pangaku, sabi
  6. style or manner of speaking
    Synonym: pamanyalita

Derived terms

[edit]
  • magsalita
  • manyalita
  • mipagsalita
  • pamagsalita
  • pamanyalita
  • papagsalita

Latin

[edit]

Participle

[edit]

salīta

  1. inflection of salītus:
    1. nominative/vocative feminine singular
    2. nominative/accusative/vocative neuter plural

Participle

[edit]

salītā

  1. ablative feminine singular of salītus

Pangasinan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Malay cerita.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • Hyphenation: sa‧li‧ta
  • IPA(key): /saliˈta/, [sa.lɪˈta]

Noun

[edit]

salitá

  1. word
  2. language
    salitang Pangasinan
    Pangasinan language

Spanish

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /saˈlita/ [saˈli.t̪a]
  • Rhymes: -ita
  • Syllabification: sa‧li‧ta

Noun

[edit]

salita f (plural salitas)

  1. diminutive of sala

Tagalog

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Old Malay (cf. modern Malay cerita (“tale”)), from Sanskrit चरित (carita, “course of life; adventures”). Compare Kapampangan salita.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /saliˈtaʔ/ [sɐ.lɪˈt̪aʔ]
  • Rhymes: -aʔ
  • Syllabification: sa‧li‧ta

Noun

[edit]

salitâ (Baybayin spelling ᜐᜎᜒᜆ)

  1. word (unit of speech)
    Synonyms: (Marinduque) ergo, (eastern Marinduque) salitain, palabra
  2. (by extension) language; speech; dialect
    Synonyms: wika, lengguwahe, diyalekto, (Marinduque) ergo
  3. something said
    Synonyms: sabi, bala (obsolete)
  4. statement; remark
    Synonym: pangungusap
  5. narration
    Synonyms: salaysay, pagsasalaysay
  6. promise; word; affirmation
    Synonym: pangako
  7. style or manner of speaking
    Synonyms: pagsasalita, pananalita
